purpose: Validate metabob-rpc-api endpoints work correctly with deployed infrastructure in local Kubernetes cluster

validationTargets.currentBehavior: Health check endpoint returns status, timestamp, version
validationTargets.gap: Already working - returns health status correctly
validationTargets.testStatus: PASS - Returns 200 OK with valid JSON

validationTargets.currentBehavior: Lists templates from Redis cache with Thompson Sampling scores, supports multi-tenant filtering via Bearer token
validationTargets.gap: Working - returns empty list initially (no templates registered yet)
validationTargets.testStatus: PASS - Returns 200 OK with empty templates array

multiTenantSupport.authenticationMode: Optional in DEBUG mode, required in production

validationTargets.currentBehavior: Creates template variants, auto-generates variant_id via content hash, stores in SurrealDB (primary) and Redis (cache)
validationTargets.desiredBehavior: Persists template to SurrealDB with multi-tenant scope, caches in Redis with TTL
validationTargets.gap: NEEDS VALIDATION - SurrealDB connection requires auth, got 401 error
validationTargets.dataFlow: Client → FastAPI route → server.actions.activity.create_template → server.db.operations.create_template_record → SurrealDB → Redis cache

validationTargets.currentBehavior: Fetches template by variant_id from Redis (cache hit) or SurrealDB (cache miss), returns full template with metrics
validationTargets.gap: NEEDS VALIDATION - depends on template creation success
validationTargets.testStatus: NOT TESTED - no templates exist yet
validationTargets.dataFlow: Client → Redis (cache check) → [cache miss] → SurrealDB → populate Redis → response

validationTargets.currentBehavior: Calculates quality score (0-100) from template metrics: success (40 pts), cost (20 pts), duration (20 pts), documentation (20 pts)
validationTargets.desiredBehavior: Returns quality score breakdown without client-side calculation
validationTargets.gap: NEW ENDPOINT - validates recent deployment includes quality score feature
validationTargets.testStatus: NOT TESTED - requires template with execution history

validationTargets.currentBehavior: Schema-tolerant execution recording - accepts minimal data (activity_id, duration_ms, success) and fills defaults
validationTargets.desiredBehavior: Accepts partial execution data, fills template_id/started_at/completed_at with defaults
validationTargets.gap: RECENT CHANGE - validates schema tolerance deployment
validationTargets.testStatus: PARTIALLY TESTED - API validation requires template_id and started_at (not truly tolerant)

optionalWithDefaults.template_id: Extracted from activity_id pattern or use activity_id

validationTargets.dataFlow: Client → FastAPI route → fill defaults → server.db.operations.insert_execution → SurrealDB → update_metrics_after_execution

dataFlowSummary.templateRetrieval: Client → api.metabob.local/v2/activities/templates/{id} (GET) → Redis cache → [miss] → SurrealDB → populate cache → response
dataFlowSummary.learningLoop: Execution → SurrealDB (activity_execution) → Aggregate (template_metrics) → Thompson Sampling → Template Selection → Next Execution

currentState.schemaToleranceEndpoint: ✗ Partially working - still requires some fields
currentState.devbobIntegration: ? DevBob can access API but not tested end-to-end

desiredState.allEndpointsAccessible: All HTTP endpoints respond without 5xx errors
desiredState.redisCaching: Redis cache populated after SurrealDB writes
desiredState.devbobWorkflows: DevBob can execute activities that call RPC API
desiredState.schemaToleranceValidated: Learning loop accepts minimal execution data
desiredState.qualityScoreValidated: Quality score endpoint returns scores for templates with history

blockers.impact: Cannot create templates in SurrealDB (primary storage)
possibleCauses: Credentials secret not mounted correctly to metabob-rpc-api pod
Database namespace/database not created during init
blockers.investigation: Check surrealdb-credentials secret, verify init-schema job ran successfully

blockers.error: Field 'template_id' and 'started_at' still required by Pydantic validation
blockers.impact: Clients must send all fields despite 'Optional' schema annotations
possibleCauses: Pydantic Field(...) still marks fields as required
API validation happening before default-filling logic

tasks: Verify surrealdb-credentials secret exists and contains valid credentials
Check metabob-rpc-api pod can read secret (kubectl describe pod)
Verify SURREAL_USER/SURREAL_PASS environment variables in pod
Test direct SurrealDB connection from rpc-api pod: curl http://surrealdb:8000
Review init-schema job logs to confirm database initialization
POST /v2/activities/templates - create test template
GET /v2/activities/templates - list templates (should include test template)
GET /v2/activities/templates/{id} - retrieve test template
Verify template stored in SurrealDB (direct query)
Verify template cached in Redis (redis-cli GET activity:template:{id})
Create template with execution history
POST /api/v1/learning-loop/executions - record multiple executions
GET /v2/activities/templates/{id}/quality-score - get quality score
Verify score calculation matches specification
Confirm client code does NOT calculate quality scores locally
Fix ExecutionRequest Pydantic model to use Field(default=None)
POST /api/v1/learning-loop/executions with minimal data (activity_id, duration, success)
Verify API fills template_id from activity_id pattern
Verify API calculates started_at from completed_at - duration
Confirm no Pydantic validation errors
Create templates with different org_id/project_id scope
GET /v2/activities/templates with Bearer token (specific org)
Verify only org-scoped + global templates returned
GET /v2/activities/templates without Bearer token
Verify only global templates returned
kubectl exec into devbob pod
Test opencode CLI can call metabob-rpc-api endpoints
Execute activity that uses template selection (Thompson Sampling)
Verify activity calls POST /v2/activities/templates/{id}/select
Confirm end-to-end workflow: DevBob → RPC API → SurrealDB → Redis → response
